description: This file defines the SubscriptionManager class, an Akka actor responsible for managing search subscriptions within a service. It handles creating, requesting, and canceling subscriptions, manages subscription actors, and interfaces with search streams, utilizing Akka streams and actor model. It also incorporates configuration for limits and logging, and interacts with various External signals and models related to search subscriptions.

classes.name: SubscriptionManager
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages search subscriptions, handles creation, requests, cancellations, and streams search results using Akka streams. It maintains subscription IDs, logs activities, and communicates with other actors and sources to facilitate dynamic search subscription management.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating SubscriptionManager actor with specified timeout, mediator, proxy, and materializer.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Sets up message handling for subscription request, creation, and cancellation.

methods.name: requestSubscription
methods.description: Forwards a request to an existing subscription actor based on subscription ID.

methods.name: cancelSubscription
methods.description: Forwards a cancellation request to an existing subscription actor based on subscription ID.

methods.name: createSubscription
methods.description: Handles creation of a new subscription, spawns a child actor and connects it to a search source.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a subscription actor with a search result stream source.

methods.name: getPageSource
methods.description: Builds an Akka stream source for the search results based on the subscription request parameters.

methods.name: nextSubscriptionId
methods.description: Generates a unique subscription ID based on a prefix and an internal counter.

methods.name: asJsonArray
methods.description: Converts a collection of strings into a JsonArray.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Parses size options from the subscription request, validating against limits.

methods.name: lazify
methods.description: Wraps a Source in a lazily-evaluated source to defer creation until materialization.
